test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the long-run production function?

options.text: In this production, only two factors of production are fixed.
In this production function, one factor of production is variable and all others are fixed.
It is the sum total of explicit and implicit costs.
In this production function, all the factors of production are variable.

solution:
The correct answer is __**In this production function, all the factors of production are variable**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The long-run production function describes the relationship between the quantities of inputs used in production and the resulting output when all inputs can be varied.
 
• In the long run, all inputs, including labor, capital, land, and raw materials, can be varied.
 
• The long-run production function emphasizes the importance of efficiency and optimization in production processes.
 
• The slope of an isoquant represents the MRTS (Marginal Rate of Technical Substitution).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Short-Run Production Functions are**:

 
 
• Fixed and Variable Inputs
 
• Law of Diminishing Returns
 
• Production Schedule
 
 
 
• **Key Features of the Long-Run Production Functions are**:
 
 
• Variable Inputs
 
• Returns to Scale
 
• Isoquants
 
• Marginal Rate of Technical Substitution (MRTS)
 
• Efficiency
 
• Efficiency
